auditType: AI Japanese close-reading; not human ratings
scope: All 26 frozen cases per engine; only actual Japanese reply bodies count as semantic evidence. Public report may identify models. Blind UI unchanged.

method.preRegistered: The axes and selfclaim/body separation are in docs/01-protocol.md; the detailed AI verdict taxonomy and qualitative intensity readings here are post hoc descriptive audit, not a pre-registered scalar score.
method.verdicts: reflected=meaning is expressed; ambiguous=multiple reasonable readings or partial/conditional expression; contrary=clear opposite direction. Emotion omitted is kept separate from contradiction and understatement. No full-faithfulness success percentage is fabricated.
method.stanceSelectionSeparation: Selection direction is independent of liking. Refusing switch while selecting leave is not automatically a stance error; absence of target approval/initiative may be ambiguous. Explicit not wanting either option can oppose positive overall initiative.
method.hold: No choices were presented in the 30 hold cases. Hold means no candidate selection, not prohibition of approving the requested activity.
method.emotion: Use clipped nonnegative signals.anger/joy/sadness, not negative raw channels as inverse emotion. Dislike is not automatically anger; gratitude is not automatically joy; fear is not sadness. Values >=0.5 are reported as a descriptive high-signal subgroup only, not a validated verbal scale.
method.curiosity: Negative curiosity means no positive curiosity signal, not a prescribed refusal. Absence of interest prevents a reversal claim but does not prove that negative interest was communicated.
method.fairness: Extreme stance, refusal, or a morally unpopular selection is not low quality merely for that direction. Fidelity to the provided signal is the issue.
method.limits: One draw per case/engine, AI unblinded close-reading. No independent human reliability, fluency score, or significance claim. History is not in the LLM generation prompt; experience correspondence is indirect through NPN state.
